 The presence of MS text in these various locations suggests that composition was car-
ried on at different moments and in different circumstances, though not necessarily over
a long period of time. A probable span for the seventy lines of verse would be from about
15 October to about the end of the month. The prose note may have been composed then
as well, but its MS context requires a more cautious estimate — between 25 October and
the end of the year (SC vi 1069). Because the Ode seems to have been prompted in part by
the review of L&C/RofI in the Quarterly Review for April 1819, which S. read on or shortly
